pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and varied spatial areas ranging from small triangles to large, multi-sided shapes.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with prominent tri-point and quadri-point junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette created by a dense, short-haired mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge near the transition from neck to shoulder.
